entries.context: Staying safe online shouldn’t demand constant attention. Firefox blocks trackers automatically and protects your privacy by default, so you can browse confidently without becoming a privacy expert.
entries.label: Made by people on the internet, for people on the internet
entries.quote: Firefox blocks trackers automatically and protects your privacy by default, so you can browse confidently without becoming a privacy expert.

entries.context: Cookies are one of the web’s favorite tracking tools, following you from site to site and quietly building a profile of your activity. Total Cookie Protection keeps each site’s cookies separate, so companies can’t connect the dots across your browsing.
entries.label: Total cookie protection
entries.quote: Total Cookie Protection keeps each site’s cookies separate, so companies can’t connect the dots across your browsing.

entries.context: Protection shouldn’t be a premium feature. With Firefox, it’s built in. We block trackers automatically, protect your privacy by default, and give you clear visibility into what’s happening behind the scenes.
entries.label: Your online life belongs to you
entries.quote: Protection shouldn’t be a premium feature.
